label: Effect-local esse-or-mode weakening of perfection-as-mode for perfection transfer (#1789)
summary: Persists the 2026-11-19 findings posted on issue #1789. They were checked only by a standalone JavaScript relation evaluator: no Lean, Comparator or corpus result certifies any of them. 5e281daf is held true in every model below; the targets probed are 791fa216, 2f6b9eff and b26c10a0. (1) Logical weakening. In the conditional derivation of b26c10a0 from 5e281daf, 2f6b9eff and 791fa216 (theorem universalCauseTransfers, result dae70d8a), the global premise 791fa216 (InAct x r -> ModeOfBeing x r) can be replaced by the constructive effect-local classification EffectLocalEsseOrMode: for a universal esse cause c, a distinct x with CausesIn c x esse and InAct x r gives r = esse or ModeOfBeing x r. The esse branch is closed by the antecedent CausesIn c x esse itself. The proof sketch is uncompiled; the classification avoids a classical case split on r = esse, which the zero-axiom Comparator of the existing result forbids (the earlier r != esse sketch used Classical.choice). Exhaustive enumeration of all 1,048,576 assignments on two beings and two respects, run with the classically equivalent r != esse form, found no assignment satisfying 5e281daf, 2f6b9eff and the weaker condition while falsifying b26c10a0. 20,944 of those assignments satisfy the other inputs and the weaker condition while falsifying the global and effect-local InAct -> ModeOfBeing forms, so the weakening is strict in that signature. Under the formal reading of InAct, q.4 a.2 co. and ad 3 (a thing actually having life or wisdom thereby has being in that mode) give the classification its strongest positive warrant. Two existing source-bearing declarations were checked and do not supply it: PerfectionOfBeing.PerfectOnlyInsofarAsBeing yields only that the bearer is in act in esse, not that r is its mode; WholePowerPerfection.PurePerfectionsPertainToBeing ranges over determination kinds and lacks the respect dictionary, the possession adapter and the token bridge to ModeOfBeing. The consumers CausalPerfectionTransfer.naming and .goodness take the unchanged b26c10a0 formula, so a certified replacement would compose without changing them. (2) Sense discriminator. A shared three-being, three-respect assignment (root, producer, recipient; esse, skill, powerToProduceSkill) evaluates InAct under IN_ACT_1 (formal) and IN_ACT_3 (formal-or-virtual) of DISAMB-IN-ACT. Under IN_ACT_1 the esse-or-mode classification and the transfer conclusion hold; under IN_ACT_3 both fail, at the producer's virtual skill. Virtual possession of skill is a mode only under a different respect index (power to produce skill), so a same-respect transport adapter is missing. This is a sense-separating control, not evidence that the virtual reading is false. (3) Concurrence control. With God(root), CausesAllInGenus(root, esse), 5e281daf, the IN_ACT_1 classification, ActualityOnlyInsofarAsBeing, PerfectionsOfEffectPreexistInCauseReading, the q.105 a.5 reading CreatedAgentIsAppliedToActByGodReading (only: some respect in which the created agent is moved) and MoverCausesWhatItMovesTo all true in a nonvacuous model, 2f6b9eff and b26c10a0 both fail at (root, recipient, skill). The present encodings do not derive the root's contribution to a secondary agent's particular effect. This is an entailment failure of the current Lean readings, not a critique of Aquinas's full q.105 a.5 argument.
blocker: The weakening leaves 2f6b9eff (a total cause of being causes each mode of being) as the central open obstacle. The secondary-only rival has this shape: result b0e72763 certifies only its background and the failed transfer, and extended by TotalCauseOfBeing on the root's esse edges and ModeOfBeing := InAct (an unchecked extension) it satisfies 5e281daf and the esse-or-mode classification, so 2f6b9eff fails with the transfer; and the current q.105 a.5 reading does not select the root as the mover of the secondary's particular operation. Under IN_ACT_3 a different-respect virtual-power adapter is also required.
